fragrances.name: Tobacco Vanille
fragrances.description: A dense, sweet pipe-tobacco and vanilla blend with dried fruit and cocoa that feels like a leather armchair beside a fire. Rich and enveloping, it does best on frosty evenings.
cons: Overwhelming in heat or small offices

fragrances.name: Oud Wood
fragrances.description: A polished, gentle oud softened with sandalwood, cardamom and creamy tonka. Dry, warm and quietly luxurious, with none of the barnyard edge of raw oud.
cons: Projection fades after the first hour

fragrances.name: Ombré Leather
fragrances.description: Soft, supple leather wrapped in cardamom, jasmine and ambery moss, like a worn jacket in cold desert air. Rugged but polished.
pros: Cheaper than the Private Blend line

fragrances.name: Grand Soir
fragrances.description: A deep, resinous amber built on labdanum and benzoin, with a soft lavender edge and a vanilla-tonka drydown. Warm and smooth rather than sticky, and made for dressed-up nights.

fragrances.name: Shalimar
fragrances.description: The classic oriental: bright bergamot melting into smoky vanilla, incense and a slightly animalic leather warmth. Glamorous and nostalgic, made for dressed-up winter nights.

fragrances.name: Opium
fragrances.description: A lavish, spice-heavy oriental of clove, carnation and resins, like incense smoke drifting through velvet drapes. Bold, dramatic and vintage in spirit.

fragrances.name: Black Opium
fragrances.description: A glossy coffee gourmand where black coffee meets vanilla and white flowers, like an espresso martini at a nightclub. Sweet, lively and seductive.

fragrances.name: Angel
fragrances.description: The first modern gourmand: candy floss and caramel set against dark, earthy patchouli, sweet and strange at once. A loud, unmistakable winter statement.
pros: The gourmand that started it all
cons: People love it or hate it

fragrances.name: A*Men
fragrances.description: A bold masculine gourmand of roasted coffee, caramel and patchouli, cut with lavender and a smoky tar edge. Dense, dark and eccentric, and built for cold weather.

fragrances.name: Spicebomb
fragrances.description: A burst of cinnamon, saffron and pepper settling onto tobacco and soft leather. Warm and confident, like mulled spice on a winter coat.

fragrances.name: Chergui
fragrances.description: Honeyed tobacco and sun-dried hay over incense, iris and amber, wrapping around you like a heavy knitted scarf. Plush, sweet and a little smoky.
cons: Hard to find in some regions

fragrances.name: Fille en Aiguilles
fragrances.description: Pine needles and fir balsam glazed with candied fruit, spice and incense smoke. It smells like a walk through a frozen conifer forest that ends by the fire.
cons: Hard to find outside niche shops

fragrances.name: Angels' Share
fragrances.description: A cognac-soaked cinnamon pastry with praline and oak, like dessert and brandy by a winter fireplace. Rich, sweet and cheerful.

fragrances.name: Layton
fragrances.description: Crisp apple and lavender melting into creamy vanilla, cardamom and woods. Polished, warm and widely liked, it works well as a cold-season date scent.
pros: Works through all the cool months

fragrances.name: Naxos
fragrances.description: Sicilian-inspired lavender and citrus poured over honey, cinnamon and golden tobacco. Luxurious and smooth, like a honey-glazed cigar lounge.

fragrances.name: Replica By the Fireplace
fragrances.description: Clove and orange blossom give way to roasted chestnut, smouldering guaiac wood and vanilla, like wool socks drying next to a hearth. Warm, nostalgic and easy to wear.
cons: Costs more per ml than designer scents

fragrances.name: Replica Jazz Club
fragrances.description: Pink pepper and neroli open onto a smooth heart of rum and clary sage before sweet tobacco leaf, vanilla and styrax take over. Mellow, cosy and easy to like.
pros: Easy to wear through the cool months

fragrances.name: Sauvage Elixir
fragrances.description: A darker, denser take on Sauvage where grapefruit quickly gives way to nutmeg, cinnamon and cardamom over licorice, lavender and ambery woods. Very strong and made for cold nights.

fragrances.name: Hypnotic Poison
fragrances.description: A dark bitter-almond and vanilla scent with a spiced caraway twist and hazy jasmine. Sultry and enveloping, like velvet on a cold night.

fragrances.name: Portrait of a Lady
fragrances.description: A regal Turkish rose with raspberry and clove over a smoky wall of patchouli, incense and benzoin. Opulent, grand and theatrical.

fragrances.name: Candy
fragrances.description: Chewy caramel and resinous benzoin wrapped in soft powdery musk. A playful candy-shop gourmand with a surprisingly grown-up resin core.

fragrances.name: Interlude Man
fragrances.description: A roaring blaze of incense, oregano and smoky amber over leather and oud, like standing by a bonfire in a stone chapel. Intense, complex and strictly for cold weather.
pros: Changes a lot as it wears

fragrances.name: Khamrah
fragrances.description: A spiced dates-and-praline gourmand with cinnamon, vanilla and resins that smells like a boozy Middle Eastern dessert. Warm, sweet and very rich for the price.

fragrances.name: London for Men
fragrances.description: Cinnamon and lavender over port wine, soft leather and tobacco leaf, like a wool overcoat on a drizzly December evening. Understated, warm and comforting.
pros: Cosy spiced tobacco for little money

fragrances.name: Le Male
fragrances.description: A clean barbershop opening of lavender and mint sinking into creamy vanilla and tonka, like freshly shaved skin under a wool sweater. A cosy, sensual 90s icon.

fragrances.name: The One for Men
fragrances.description: A smooth, gentlemanly amber-tobacco scent with a bright grapefruit and spice opening. Refined and understated, it suits both cold-weather dinners and offices.
cons: Sits close to the skin after an hour

fragrances.name: Coco
fragrances.description: Clove-spiked rose and mimosa settle into a deep labdanum and sandalwood amber with a faint animal purr. Opulent, formal and unmistakably grown-up.

fragrances.name: 9pm
fragrances.description: A sweet, club-ready blend of vanilla, lavender and cinnamon built to project on cold nights out. Loud, sugary and fun.

fragrances.name: L'Air du Désert Marocain
fragrances.description: A dry, luminous desert dusk of incense, cistus, cedar and warm amber, hazy with spice. Meditative and radiant, and at its best in cold air.
